captured_from: 2026-11-13 user-supplied technology family matrix and fencepost error discussion
namespace_rule: Technology family IDs 1–12 and technology unit IDs 1–108 belong to technology-v108 namespace; they do not renumber ONE family 21 or Families 65–75 / members 65–163.

counting_contract.unit_indexing: family_position is one-based 1..9; Python slices are zero-based and half-open
counting_contract.fail_closed_on: duplicate, omitted, extra, unclassified, or ambiguous boundary

families.technological_era: Prehistoric & Ancient Foundational Tech (Stone, Bronze & Simple Machines)
families.name: The Lithic, Fire & Primitive-Tool Family
families.tech_root: Knapped flint blades, controlled fire hearths, woven cordage, pottery kilns, and bone needles.
families.mission: Transform raw earth, wood, and fire into basic survival tools, shelters, and preserved food with zero external supply chains.

families.technological_era: Prehistoric & Ancient Foundational Tech (Stone, Bronze & Simple Machines)
families.name: The Agricultural, Irrigation & Fermentation Family
families.tech_root: The heavy plow, qanat underground aqueducts, Archimedes screws, terrace farming, grain mills, and ancient food preservation (salting, drying, fermenting).
families.mission: Engineer soil, water flow, and biological fermentation to feed dense populations reliably across seasons.

families.technological_era: Prehistoric & Ancient Foundational Tech (Stone, Bronze & Simple Machines)
families.name: The Metallurgy, Glass & Ceramic-Kiln Family
families.tech_root: Copper/tin bronze smelting, iron bloomeries, crucible Damascus steel, glassblowing, and high-fire porcelain.
families.mission: Extract, alloy, and heat-treat raw minerals into durable cutting edges, transparent optics, and heat-proof vessels.

families.technological_era: Classical & Medieval Mechanical Tech (Gears, Optics & Navigation)
families.name: The Clockwork, Windmill & Waterwheel Family
families.tech_root: Overshot waterwheels, vertical windmills, compound gear trains, escapement clocks, and the Antikythera astronomical calculator.
families.mission: Capture natural wind, water, and spring tension to automate milling, pumping, and precision mechanical timekeeping.

families.technological_era: Classical & Medieval Mechanical Tech (Gears, Optics & Navigation)
families.name: The Maritime, Cartography & Celestial-Navigation Family
families.tech_root: Clinker-built hulls, lateen sails, sternpost rudders, magnetic compasses, astrolabes, sextants, and marine chronometers.
families.mission: Navigate open oceans and uncharted terrain using stars, magnetism, and precision geometry.

families.technological_era: Classical & Medieval Mechanical Tech (Gears, Optics & Navigation)
families.name: The Printing Press, Paper & Cryptographic-Cipher Family
families.tech_root: Woodblock printing, Gutenberg’s movable metal type, rag-paper mills, mechanical cipher wheels, and early optical semaphores.
families.mission: Mass-produce accurate written records, standardize schematics, and secure sensitive dispatches across long distances.

families.name: The Steam, Internal-Combustion & Turbine Family
families.tech_root: Watt’s condensing steam engine, high-pressure locomotives, Otto/Diesel combustion engines, and Parsons steam/gas turbines.
families.mission: Convert fossil, solar, or thermal heat into high-torque rotational power for factories, rail networks, and aviation.

families.name: The Electrification, Power-Grid & Telecommunications Family
families.tech_root: Faraday dynamos, Tesla AC polyphase motors, high-voltage transformers, telegraph/telephone switches, and vacuum-tube radio.
families.mission: Generate, step up, transmit, and modulate electromagnetic energy to power cities and carry instant voice/data globally.

families.technological_era: Modern Silicon, Quantum & Bio-Digital Tech (Compute, Space & Atoms)
families.name: The Semiconductor, Photonic & Cloud-Compute Family
families.tech_root: Transistors, integrated circuits, EUV lithography, fiber-optic lasers, TCP/IP packet routers, and hyperscale GPU clusters.
families.mission: Etch microscopic silicon/photonic logic gates to process, route, and store planetary-scale information at the speed of light.

families.technological_era: Modern Silicon, Quantum & Bio-Digital Tech (Compute, Space & Atoms)
families.name: The Autonomous Robotics, Additive-3D & Drone-Swarm Family
families.tech_root: CNC multi-axis mills, industrial 3D metal/polymer printers, LiDAR spatial SLAM, bipedal actuators, and autonomous drone swarms.
families.mission: Translate digital CAD files directly into physical parts and deploy self-navigating machines across factories, farms, and disaster zones.

families.technological_era: Modern Silicon, Quantum & Bio-Digital Tech (Compute, Space & Atoms)
families.name: The Aerospace, Orbital-Satellite & Propulsion Family
families.tech_root: Fly-by-wire avionics, reusable liquid-fuel rockets, ion thrusters, GPS atomic-clock constellations, and deep-space radio arrays.
families.mission: Escape Earth’s gravity well, maintain global satellite communications/navigation, and explore orbital and planetary frontiers.
